articles.title: Govt disburses Rs 36,754 cr under PLI schemes as on June 30
articles.summary: The government has disbursed Rs 36,754 crore by June 30 under Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes. This significant financial support aims to boost domestic manufacturing across various sectors, enhance exports, and reduce import dependence. The initiative strengthens India's economic self-reliance and fosters job creation, aligning with the 'Make in India' vision for national development and a stronger economy.

articles.title: PH Navy frigate leads ADMM-Plus sea drills in WPS
articles.summary: The Philippine Navy (PN) announced its guided-missile frigate, BRP Jose Rizal (FFG-14), spearheaded an at-sea operational activity. This event highlights the Philippine armed forces' ongoing efforts to enhance maritime security and operational readiness. Such deployments are crucial for projecting naval power, safeguarding national territorial integrity, and fostering regional stability through continuous presence and exercises.

articles.title: From hyperon-nucleon interactions to deuteron-hyperon femtoscopy
articles.summary: This research investigates low-energy scattering and femtoscopic correlations in d-systems using a microscopic folding approach. It examines effective deuteron-hyperon interactions, crucial for understanding fundamental subatomic forces. Such theoretical physics studies advance scientific knowledge, indirectly benefiting fields like materials science or advanced technology by deepening our understanding of matter at its most basic level.

articles.title: India's journey towards 'Viksit Bharat' being written in rockets built on Indian soil: ISRO chief
articles.summary: India's 'Viksit Bharat' vision is significantly propelled by its advancements in space technology, featuring indigenously built rockets and cryogenic engines. This emphasizes India's growing self-reliance and technological prowess in critical high-tech sectors, overcoming past limitations where global partners once denied access. This progress underscores India's strengthening position in scientific innovation and national development.

articles.title: At least four killed in Ukraine Russia drone strike exchange
articles.summary: Recent drone attacks across Russia and Ukraine have resulted in at least four fatalities, including a 14-year-old child. Officials from both nations confirmed casualties, with Russia reporting Ukrainian drone strikes and Ukraine documenting deadly Russian assaults. These cross-border incidents underscore the escalating conflict, highlighting its significant human cost and the persistent security challenges in the region, crucial for SSB aspirants to understand.

articles.title: India's journey towards 'Viksit Bharat' being written in rockets built on Indian soil: ISRO chief
articles.summary: India's 'Viksit Bharat' vision extends to space, powered by indigenous rockets and advanced cryogenic engines. This technological prowess, once a global challenge, now exemplifies India's self-reliance and strength. Such progress positions the nation as a formidable global leader in space, fostering national pride and ensuring future strategic advantages.

articles.title: microcubed added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article describes how to calculate 3D magnetic stray fields and analytical gradients for uniformly magnetized, axis-aligned cuboids and their arrangements. It highlights Microcubed software, which offers NumPy and compiled, parallel Rust backends to perform these computations efficiently. This technical capability is vital for advanced scientific and engineering applications requiring precise magnetic field modeling.

articles.title: Quote Of The Day By Lili Reinhart: 'I'm Always On A Quest To Feel Better. I've Never Been Someone Who Accepts A Diagnosis That Has No Cure...'
articles.summary: Prime Video has released a new romantic comedy, "The Love Hypothesis," starring Lili Reinhart. The film adapts a popular BookTok novel, following Olive, a Stanford PhD science student, who embarks on a fake dating premise. This rom-com brings a beloved internet obsession to the screen, focusing on themes of academia and relationships in a lighthearted manner.

articles.title: Allies back Saudis as Houthi attacks threaten key oil route
articles.summary: Military chiefs from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are scheduled to meet to discuss potential assistance for Saudi Arabia. This initiative comes as Saudi Arabia continues to face persistent attacks from Yemen's Houthi rebels. The talks underscore regional efforts to address ongoing security challenges and strengthen defence cooperation amidst geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
